text:
tiago: Heads-up — noticed a delayed token ingestion window for yesterday (2026-03-22 22:00-23:30 UTC). Several invoices missing ~1.2M tokens each. Filing here so we can track remediation.
ops_bot: alert: ingestion-lag detected (kinesis-consumer-lag > 120s) for shard consumer-7.
anna_fin: Do we know impacted customers? rough estimate of invoices?
tiago: initial query shows ~14 customers with >$200 discrepancy, most on metered hosted API. Query used: ```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS missing_tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-22 22:00' AND '2026-03-22 23:30'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
sasha_ml: likely caused by transient consumer OOM after model-latency spike; I saw autoscaler thrashing in the logs (scale up -> fail -> scale down loop).
mike_eng: I can take ownership of the backfill pipeline. Plan: replay S3 batches + re-run metering job. ETA for backfill: EOD tomorrow. Will also add dedupe guard.
anna_fin: thanks. we need a timeline for finance to issue corrected invoices and credits. Can we get a PRD for customer communications? cc @jen_csm
jen_csm: I'll draft a customer email template and escalate to AMs. Need confirmed list of impacted accounts and per-account shortage amounts.
tiago: attaching short list in this thread (private link): https://redwood.s3/ingest/1891234567/impacted.csv — contains account_id, estimated_missing_tokens, est_credit_usd
mike_eng: backfill steps: 1) restart consumer with `--max-memory=6G` 2) run replay: `python tools/replay_tokens.py --from=2026-03-22T22:00 --to=2026-03-22T23:30` 3) postprocess and update ledger. Will open a PR with runbook.
sasha_ml: also recommend we add metric `token_consumer_lag` alert at 60s instead of 120s to catch earlier.
anna_fin: for billing ops: if backfill completes by tomorrow noon, can we target invoice corrections in this week's billing cycle? Finance needs 24h to process credits.
mike_eng: aiming to complete backfill by 11:00 UTC tomorrow. If anything slips I'll shout here.
tiago: action items: mike -> backfill owner (ETA 11:00 UTC tomorrow), sasha -> alert tuning + root cause postmortem, anna -> prepare credit amounts + customer comms, jen -> customer outreach. We'll sync 09:30 UTC tomorrow. :+1:
ops_bot: deploy-bot: mike_eng started replay-job run-1891234578 (logs: https://logs.redwood/1891234578)
jen_csm: noted — I'll draft email now and share for review in #finance.
